name: empirical-memory
description: Cross-tool, cross-project memory for Codex CLI. Start an idea in ChatGPT, pick it up in Codex with full context carried over. Track leads and relationships as durable memory instead of a separate CRM. Organize memory into separate workspaces for personal, team, or client contexts. Recalls prior decisions and conventions across sessions, and persists new ones as you work.

interface.shortDescription: Portable memory across AI tools and projects.
interface.longDescription: Carry durable context, decisions, preferences, and work history across Claude Code, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, and ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Recall relevant context for this project.
Save this decision to Empirical memory.
